claim: Let \(\alpha(a)=(a,247/250-a,3/500,3/500)\) and \(\beta=(19/20,3/100,1/50,0)\), with \(9/10\le a<19/20\). If deterministic LOCC self-catalysis with \(N\) catalyst copies is possible, i.e. \[\alpha(a)^{\otimes(N+1)}\prec\beta\otimes\alpha(a)^{\otimes N},\]then necessarily \[N\ge R(a):=\frac{40a}{(19-20a)(247-250a)}.\]The bound comes from the single majorization prefix of length \(N+2\), whose source sum is \(a^N[a+(N+1)(247/250-a)]\) and whose target sum is \(a^{N-1}[(49/50)a+(19/20)N(247/250-a)]\). Consequently every successful self-catalytic conversion in this family needs at least \(\lceil R(a)\rceil\) catalyst copies, and \[R(a)=\frac{1}{5(19/20-a)}-\frac{104}{19}+O(19/20-a)\]as \(a\uparrow19/20\). Thus no fixed finite catalyst-copy budget works uniformly along the family. For the five multi-copy examples tabulated by Duarte, Drumond, and Terra Cunha at \(a=0.900,0.908,0.918,0.925,0.928\), the lower bounds are respectively \(18/11,227/105,459/140,296/63,928/165\), whose ceilings are \(2,3,4,5,6\). Combined with the successful conversions recorded in their Table I, this gives a single analytic certificate of the minimal copy counts for all five rows.

integrity.computational_dependence: none for the continuous lower bound; exact tensor-product replay verifies the five finite examples
integrity.novelty_scope: A single exact majorization-prefix obstruction for the affine family underlying the source's five multi-copy examples, including a divergent copy-number lower bound and analytic certification of all five tabulated minima.
integrity.prior_work_preserved: The self-catalysis examples and their successful copy counts are credited to Duarte--Drumond--Terra Cunha; the general relevance of arbitrarily many copies in multiple-copy transformation is credited to Duan--Feng--Li--Ying.

scientific_limitations: The continuous formula is a necessary lower bound on catalyst-copy number, not a sufficient criterion for every parameter value.
Exact sufficiency and minimality are asserted only at the five tabulated source points, where the source provides successful conversions and the packaged checker replays them.
The divergence is specific to the natural affine family formed by the five source examples.
The result is for deterministic LOCC conversion of bipartite pure states.
title: A sharp copy-number obstruction along a self-catalytic Schmidt-vector family
